messages:
Maya: heads-up 1 launch-week social schedule draft is up. primary goals: webinar signup, benchmark narrative, and routing high-intent replies to SDRs.
Jeremy: on it. proposing triple-format per hero asset: X thread, LinkedIn longpost, and a 30s hero clip (plus 15s cut).
Emily: I can deliver the clip + carousel frames. need final copy and CTA variants by EOD tomorrow. tagging design for thumbnails.
Sam: SDR note 1 any post with webinar CTA must include utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_launch so webhook routing can send leads to the webinar SDR queue. Also define keywords for high-intent triage.
Maya: Sam, recommended keyword or CTA string?
Sam: use exact phrases: "Interested demo" or "Book call" in replies; for signup forms tag as "webinar_sign_up" and assign lead_score 50+. DM form link will surface directly to SDR inbox.
Jeremy: draft copy ideas for the benchmark thread (two variants):
A) Tech-first: "Latency down 3x, cost down 2x 1 how we optimized inference for production. Webinar Thurs 11am PT. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_launch"
B) PM/ops angle: "Ship LLM features in days, not months. Join our webinar for the checklist + demo. Register: {link}?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=may_launch"
Maya: prefer A on X, B on LinkedIn. make sure the X variant references the graph in the hero clip.
Emily: quick question on thumbnail: should clips show the benchmark graph or the product UI? Graph reads faster in feed.
Maya: graph for X; UI for LinkedIn. Emily, please include both frame variants in Figma.
SocialBot: scheduling preview created 1 4 X posts, 3 LinkedIn longposts, 1 carousel, 2 clips. Preview: https://redwood.social/schedule/preview/1778889999 1 reacts :white_check_mark:.
Jeremy: also proposing a small customer-quote microthread on day 3 (2 tweets): builds social proof and links to webinar. I'll collect 3 short blurbs from beta customers.
Sam: routing + triage timeline: replies with keywords get flagged immediately; SDRs have a 24hr triage window. Signups via form get tag + score, then routed to SDR workflow. I'll push a test webhook today.
Emily: asset timeline: will deliver Figma frames and both clip sizes by EOD tomorrow. Need brand approval on thumbnails; looping in Brand now.
Maya: paid boost: we want one boosted X post targeted at developer audiences and one LinkedIn sponsored for product managers. budget proposal pending.
Jeremy: quick A/B plan: run benchmark data-led thread vs developer quickstart thread; measure CTR to signup and high-intent replies.
Sam: note on tracking: ensure reply pipeline logs original tweet ID and user handle so SDRs can reply contextually.
Maya: next steps: Jeremy finalize copy by tomorrow 11am, Emily deliver assets by EOD, Sam confirm webhook and tagging automation, I'll finalize schedule & boost list. Final sign-off check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :tada:
